pages.title: Direct sowing and nursery
pages.text: TFC seeds keep TFC direct sowing. A and B seeds follow their species propagation method:$(br2)$(li)seed-direct species can be sown on farmland normally;$(li)nursery, runner, tuber, rhizome, corm, crown and division species must go through the nursery tray.$(br2)The planted seed still needs a valid seedling transplant for non-direct species.

pages.title: Nursery tray
pages.text: Place an A or B seed in the nursery tray. The tray grows a seedling; take the seedling out when it is ready.

pages.title: Transplant
pages.text: Right-click suitable farmland with a seedling to plant it. The tray, seed and seedling keep their data across save and chunk reload.

pages.title: Seed treatment
pages.text: Seeds may carry one of three saved treatment states: soaked, germinated or dressed. The treatment is stored on the seed stack, not in a global player flag.

pages.title: Nursery tray
pages.text: The tray is the A/B seed propagation station. TFC seeds do not need it.

pages.title: Seedling
pages.text: Take the seedling out of the tray, then transplant it onto valid farmland.
